channel.title: Pier & Point · Correction
channel.description: Correction changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: The Uber 3 & 4 page now shows that February 2025 press reports disagree on who leases the offices (The Real Deal: Uber and the Warriors each lease office space; Commercial Observer: both buildings are 100 percent leased to Uber). The 2021 completion date now rests on the SF Standard alone; Office Snapshots shows 'Year 2020' without saying what it means.
item.description: The Uber 3 & 4 page now shows that February 2025 press reports disagree on who leases the offices (The Real Deal: Uber and the Warriors each lease office space; Commercial Observer: both buildings are 100 percent leased to Uber). Source: The Real Deal, 2025-02-14 (therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2025/02/14/warriors-uber-alexandria-bag-500m-loan-for-office-complex/); Commercial Observer, 2025-02-11; Office Snapshots, 2022-01-24.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision: The page said the UC Regents approved the Block 33 building's budget and design on January 26, 2017, citing a UCSF news page that was not read (and whose listed access date was wrong). It now cites the Regents' own records, which were read: the minutes of January 26, 2017 show the Board approving the Finance and Capital Strategies Committee's recommendations, which include a $237.13 million budget and the building's design. The agenda item gives a proposed schedule of completion by July 2019, with construction starting in June 2017. The Regents' documents call it the Mission Bay East Campus Phase 1 Building (Block 33), not the Valley Center for Vision, and describe a 343,000-gross-square-foot building, mostly academic and administrative workspace; the page now lists that as an open question.

item.title: Correction · 409/499 Illinois Street: The page said 499 Illinois Street is Assessor lot 3940005.
